banner.title: The Aronson illusionist deltas - mighty magic miscellany (folios 23-25): the 11th-14th XP progression, the manufacture thresholds, the +4 illusion save, and the Prismatic Spray two-color mechanic
banner.provenance: Pinned from The Dragon Vol. 1 No. 1 (June 1976): folio 23, Peter Aronson's Mighty Magic Miscellany - the Illusionist Additions; folio 25, the Prismatic Spray explanation and the two manufacture/save notes. The voice rides extract/dragon/001/. DELTAS ONLY per the issue-1 adjudication: most of Aronson's list was later canonized into the 1e PHB illusionist (the r183/r229 layers already pin the canon); this round pins only the divergences. OD&D-era ink converted per the walk doctrine: the pin IS the conversion, noted, never silent.
banner.sentinel: The variant-layer doctrine holds: Dragon ink is never core 1e canon. Aronson's deltas ride against the engine's 1e illusionist canon, never rewrites: his 11th-14th progression diverges from the PHB ladder, Dispel Exhaustion is non-canon, the manufacture thresholds (minor 9th, scrolls/wands 10th) and the +4 illusion/light save are his doctrine, and his Prismatic Spray rolls a d8 where 8 means two colors - roll again twice, ignoring 8s - and rides seated at the 6th level where the PHB canon seats it 7th.

audit_comment: THE ARONSON ILLUSIONIST DELTAS - Round C of the Dragon walk, deltas only on the variant layer. THE XP PROGRESSION (folio 23): his 11th-14th illusionist ladder - 525,000 / 700,000 / 875,000 / 1,050,000, a flat 175,000-point step, diverging from the 1e PHB ladder the engine already canonizes (r183/r229). THE MANUFACTURE AND SAVE NOTES (folio 25): minor items (talking puppets, toys) from the 9th level, illusionist scrolls and illusion wands from the 10th, and illusionists +4 on saves vs things involving illusions or light. THE SPELL DELTAS (folios 23, 25): Dispel Exhaustion - the non-canon 3rd-level spell, the illusion of being rested with twice the rest owed after, the raised-and-wounded clause at 1-6 extra damage; the borrowed-MU doctrine (eight MU spells ride his list, Ventriloquism altered to range 9 and duration 5 turns); and his Prismatic Spray - a d8 where 8 means two colors, roll again twice ignoring 8s, seated at the 6th level where the PHB canon seats it 7th. HONEST BOUNDARIES: deltas only per the issue-1 adjudication - the spells Aronson listed that 1e later canonized ride the existing canon layers untouched, never re-pinned here; all ink is OD&D-era variant, converted, noted, never silent. The Round B gap box flips this round - the dragon report's second flip.
